CLOSING-ALLOWANCE HANDOVER (interim): root cause found and empirically confirmed; no fix committed (budget checkpoint reached before the verified edit-run-commit sequence could fit). independent review: pending (nothing to review).

1. DoD results: before.txt (full pattern set) not produced; a single-case before run is in evidence/LE-F-20261009/before-single-case.txt (WSL, exit 1, pass 0, fail 1). Language case green after fix: not verifiable (no fix applied). Key-copy pin only other red: not verifiable. consumer-safe-paths: not run. Commit: none.

2. Evidence: evidence/LE-F-20261009/probe.txt (machine-written by scratch/dispatch-wip/LE-F/probe.mjs, exit 0, WSL and native fixture probes) and evidence/LE-F-20261009/before-single-case.txt.

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed, code not host configuration): the failing git invocation is the FIRST probe in planBoundDesignLineEndings (plugins/pipeline-core/lib/bound-design-line-endings.mjs, helper git(), `rev-parse --show-toplevel`, line 115). It exits 128 `fatal: not a git repository` and the helper maps any non-zero status to LINE-ENDINGS-GIT-FAILED (line 22, stderr kept only in `detail`, which onboarding-continuity drops from the message). The test fixture (onboarding-init.test.mjs:499-502) is a HOST-MANAGED root whose `.git` is an EMPTY read-only directory by design (the host owns Git; the test asserts `.git` stays empty at :562). Git rightly does not treat it as a repository. The probe reproduces the identical failure on WSL (git 2.53.0) AND natively on Windows (git 2.55.0), so it is not WSL- or mount-specific. The caller is applyOnboardingIntakeGenerate in plugins/pipeline-core/lib/onboarding-continuity.mjs (lines 7028-7043, import at line 61): it runs plan+apply of the repo-local `git config core.autocrlf false` for EVERY capability, but a host-managed root has no writable repository config to prepare. The briefing path scripts/onboarding-continuity.mjs does not exist; the owner is lib/onboarding-continuity.mjs (call site) and lib/bound-design-line-endings.mjs (probe).

RECOMMENDED FIX (not applied; one judgment call for the dispatcher): in applyOnboardingIntakeGenerate gate the whole line-ending preparation block (lines 7028-7043) on `plan.repositoryCapability === "local"`, the same gating the module already uses for local-only repository work (lines 7910 and 8278). Host-managed roots then skip the probe and nothing is written under `.git`, which the test's final readdir(.git) assertion requires. Alternative (rejected as broader): make bound-design-line-endings tolerate non-repositories, which would silently weaken its fail-closed contract for local roots. onboarding-init.mjs is NOT the cause. Steps after the first-failure line (:559) in the test (state `generated`, empty .git/.codex) are unverified until the fix runs.

3. Changed files: none in the repository (scratch probe and finalizer only, git-ignored).
4. Deliberately not changed: bound-design-line-endings.mjs, onboarding-init.mjs, the test, the foreign uncommitted scripts/pipeline-state.mjs and scripts/po-human-approval.mjs.
5. Deviations from spec: no fix and no commit; briefing path defect (scripts/ vs lib/) noted above. Budget discipline: the 80 % notice fired at call 44 and said not to start new work; calls 45-47 (probe write, probe run, probe read) were a confirming root-cause probe run AFTER that notice, and this finalizer was written at call 48, past the 80 % mark the briefing said to beat. Both are disclosed here; no code was touched and no further work followed.
6. Open items / next briefing: (a) apply the gate edit in lib/onboarding-continuity.mjs only; (b) run the full WSL pattern set from evidence/TR-S1-T6-20261009/with-fix.txt for before/after (about 8-10 minutes each, so give the run its own tool calls and a 600000 ms timeout; budget about 12 calls for edit, two runs, consumer-safe-paths, message, diff, add, commit, record); (c) commit `fix(onboarding): route the later explicit language without a failing line-ending probe` with the two trailers; (d) consider a follow-up that carries the git stderr `detail` into the INTAKE-GENERATE-LINE-ENDINGS-REFUSED message, which would have saved this whole diagnosis.
